findings.mechanism: 07-connection-pools — a pool is a queue; oversizing it relative to worker count creates more concurrent connections than the database can handle, leading to connection exhaustion and full worker saturation (cite 07-connection-pools).
findings.remediation: Set pool_size=10 and max_overflow=5 (or any values such that workers*(pool_size+max_overflow) ≤ 97, the usable max_connections for the default Postgres config).
findings.arithmetic: workers=4 (Dockerfile uvicorn --workers 4); total_connections=workers*(pool_size+max_overflow)=4*(20+10)=120. Default max_connections=100, reserved superuser slots≈3 → usable=97. 120 > 97, so at peak load active connections will reach ≥97, exhausting the pool and saturating all workers.

prediction.condition: 4 workers, pool_size=20, max_overflow=10, sustained high request rate
